messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning to deploy 'orbit' service v2.3 to prod TODAY at 22:00 PT (~40m). Primary goals: model switch to v2.3-quant, lower token cost, keep p50 < 200ms. Owners: @mei smoke, @sudh rollback, @jordan infra monitoring. Please ACK and call out any blockers. :eyes:

mei: Acked. I will run the smoke checklist and post results. I have a small question: are we doing canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% ramp or straight 20% canary?

alex: plan is 5% canary for 15m -> 25% for additional 10m -> full. If anything exceeds thresholds we'll abort and rollback.

sam: one quick ask — does v2.3 change output schema for the tool-calling path? I think there was one extra field in the evals. If yes, we should toggle compatibility mode.

mei: no schema change expected for tool-calling. I ran the preflight diff against our sample prompts; differences are tokenization-ish only. Still I'll validate the tool-calls during smoke.

deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled: 2026-03-17T22:00:00-07:00. CI checks passing: unit/integ/lint ✅. Canary slot reserved on pool-2 (GPUs: a40x2).

jordan: I'll watch infra dashboards and tail logs. Important dashboards: `orbit/p95-latency`, `orbit/error-rate`, `gpu-util` and tracing for `orbit.prediction`. I will post a link once the canary is live.

mei: Smoke checklist (I will post results inline):
- smoke-1: health endpoints ok (`/healthz`)
- smoke-2: end-to-end gen smoke using sample prompt set (5 requests) -> target p50 < 200ms, p95 < 800ms
- smoke-3: function/tool calling scenario x3
- smoke-4: KV cache priming check (warm cache hit rate > 70%)
- smoke-5: logs trace correlator working (trace ids present)
- smoke-6: telemetry: cost/req metrics flowing to console

mei: Running step smoke-1 now...

mei: smoke-1: `/healthz` OK on all canary nodes :white_check_mark:

mei: smoke-2: running 5 sample gen requests (script below)```\ncurl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/orbit/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize the input.","max_tokens":32}'\n```

mei: smoke-2 results: 5/5 success, p50=145ms, p95=420ms ✅

sam: nice numbers. any change to token accounting we should be aware of?

alex: token accounting will show slight drop in cost due to quantization. Not more than 6% delta by our bench. Still logged under cost-experiments tag.

mei: smoke-3: tool-calls x3 — all returned expected payloads ✅

mei: smoke-4: cache priming observed hit rate 74% ✅

jordan: infra note: one canary node reported transient gRPC backlog spike at t+3m but recovered after autoscaler trimmed queue. I saw one 503 in logs (user-agent: health-checker) but not from real traffic. Marking as non-blocker.

sudh: rollback checklist (quick):
1) toggle route back to v2.2 via `rbctl traffic set orbit --version v2.2`
2) if route toggle fails, disable canary lane in gateway `gatewayctl disable-lane orbit-canary`
3) if catastrophic, trigger infra emergency job `infra-rollback-orbit` (this reverts infra image + terraform apply)
4) open incident channel #incidents and run postmortem template

sudh: I will be on call and ready to execute steps. Also have a snapshot of v2.2 config at `s3://redwood-backups/orbit/v2.2-20260316.tar.gz`.

alex: Please confirm you can run those commands from the oncall box (no VPN issues).

sudh: Confirmed. Tested `rbctl` from jumpbox earlier today.

mei: Final smoke pass done at t+12m of canary: no regressions, latency stable, traces look clean. All green from my side.

alex: Great — can everyone who is ready please post :thumbsup: so I can flip the canary at scheduled time?

mei: :thumbsup:

sudh: :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup: infra ready, monitoring dashboards pinned and alerts set to high-sensitivity for first 30m.

sam: :thumbsup: good to go from client compatibility side.

alex: deploying now to 5% canary...

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: 5% -> nodes pool-2. Version: orbit@v2.3-quant. Trace id: c3f1a2b.

jordan: canary live. p50=150ms, p95=460ms, error-rate=0.12% (within threshold).

mei: verified tool-calls and tool payloads on canary. logs/trace ok.

alex: will monitor for 15m then bump to 25% if green. Call out anything unusual.

jordan: one observation: slight increase in GPU mem churn during long requests — p95 still fine. I'll continue watching.

sudh: standing by for rollback. All rollback commands prepped.

alex: bumping to 25% now (manual).

deploy-bot: Traffic updated: 25% canary.

jordan: 25% metrics: p50=148ms, p95=470ms, error-rate=0.14% — looks healthy. No manual intervention needed.

mei: final checks good. I approve full rollout.

alex: thanks everyone — completing full rollout now. Will open a short follow-up thread with perf delta and cost numbers. Great job. :rocket:
